name: AgentSecBench-LLM
description: Governed ground truth for offline AI auditor scoring with public/held-out splits

splits.notes: Public cases may be used for development. Held-out cases are for evaluation reports only; avoid tuning scorers/prompts against them.

leaderboard_policy: Do not publish a definitive model leaderboard with fewer than independently reviewed held-out results from external agents.
limitations: Offline scoring of submitted JSON is not live model evaluation.
Title-overlap matching is intentionally lexical; human review remains authoritative.
Eight curated cases — sample size is too small for definitive rankings.
Maintainer-authored pilots are not a substitute for external agent submissions.
